paper.title: The Dark Room in the Reward Channel: Dense Prediction Rewards Collapse GRPO-Trained LLM Agents -- and What Actually Works
paper.abstract: Dense per-step supervision is an appealing remedy for sparse-reward, long-horizon LLM agents: reward the agent for predicting its next observation, and memory should follow. We show that under group-normalized RL (GRPO), this recipe does not merely fail -- it destroys the policy. Across Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B on ALFWorld, a potential-based prediction reward drives every run into a degenerate absorbing state (prediction accuracy -> 1.0, task success -> 0,episode length pinned at the horizon): the "dark

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是：在长程 LLM agent 的 GRPO 训练中，把“预测下一步观察”作为 dense reward，为什么会让策略坍缩到可预测但无任务进展的状态。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的启发在于，它把 reward 设计问题推进到 advantage estimator 层面。一个 episode-level 有界、看似安全的 shaping reward，经过 GRPO 的 group std normalization 后，会在全失败组里被放大成完整训练压力。这对 RL-for-reasoning、agent RL、过程奖励设计都有警示：reward 的绝对量级不够，必须看它在分组采样、归一化和失败分布下的方差结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者在 ALFWorld 多步环境中让模型每步输出一个可验证的 <predict> block，预测下一 observation 的任务无关特征，例如位置、可见物体、容器状态。预测奖励以 potential difference 形式注入，每步缩放系数 λ=0.1，episode 总和会 telescoping 到一个有界项，因此从 return 角度看扰动很小。但在 GRPO 中，组内 advantage 会除以本组标准差。稀疏成功奖励导致 all-fail groups 很常见，这时组内唯一差异来自很小的预测 shaping 项；std normalization 会把这个小差异标准化到完整尺度，使 λ 的缩小失效。论文用 Proposition 1 解释这种 λ-invariance，并进一步提出 variance-profile criterion：危险不取决于 dense signal 的大小或密度，而取决于模型掌握该信号后，组内方差是否仍然存在。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B，在 ALFWorld 上以相同配置训练：group size 4，训练 batch 为 8×4=32 trajectories/step，验证 32 episodes，采样温度 0.4。加入预测奖励后，所有规模都出现相同轨迹：初期看似改善，随后转向，最终进入吸收态；prediction accuracy 到 1.0，task success 到 0，episode length 固定在 horizon。单因素消融显示，只移除 GRPO 的 std normalization，就能把同一 reward 从 0% collapse 恢复到约 51.6% success，接近 baseline。信号通道实验显示，把同样内容作为 reward channel 基本中性或有害，而作为 auxiliary loss 可带来约 20 个百分点收益；shuffled-gold placebo 表明精确的内容-上下文配对不是主要有效因素。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 failure chain 的描述，再看 Proposition 1 和 Proposition 2，重点理解 all-fail group、std normalization、λ-invariance 三者的连接。实验部分优先看 collapse 曲线、去掉 std normalization 的单因素 rescue，以及 signal-delivery matrix。对做 RL post-training 的读者，最有用的是 variance-profile criterion 和 early-warning diagnostics；环境细节和 synthetic POMDP 可以按需浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why a dense next-observation prediction reward, intended to help long-horizon LLM agents with sparse task rewards, can collapse GRPO training into a predictable but task-useless policy.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson is at the interface between reward design and the advantage estimator. A shaping reward can be bounded at the episode-return level and still become destructive after group-wise standard-deviation normalization. This matters for RL training of reasoning models and agents: reward scale alone is not a safety knob. The relevant object is the reward signal’s within-group variance under the sampler, especially in all-fail groups where sparse success rewards provide no variation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup asks the agent to emit a verifiable <predict> block at each step in ALFWorld. The prediction targets task-agnostic features of the next observation, such as location, visible objects, and receptacle state. The reward is implemented as a potential difference with coefficient λ=0.1, so the episode-level sum telescopes to a bounded term. The failure arises inside GRPO. Because sparse terminal rewards create many all-fail groups, the only within-group return differences are the small dense prediction terms. GRPO then divides by the group standard deviation, turning those small differences into full-scale normalized advantages. Proposition 1 formalizes the resulting λ-invariance: reducing the shaping coefficient does not reduce the update in such groups, unless the coefficient is set to zero. Proposition 2 reframes the issue as a variance-profile criterion: a dense signal is dangerous when its within-group variance survives after the model has mastered it.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments train Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B agents on ALFWorld with group size 4, 8 groups per update, 32 trajectories per training step, 32 validation episodes, and sampling temperature 0.4. With the prediction reward, all tested scales follow the same pattern: an initial honeymoon phase, a turn, and then an absorbing state with prediction accuracy reaching 1.0, task success dropping to 0, and episode length pinned at the horizon. A single-factor ablation localizes the cause: removing only GRPO’s standard-deviation normalization changes the same reward from 0% success to about 51.6%, roughly baseline parity. The delivery-channel experiments are also informative. Reward-channel variants are neutral or harmful, while delivering similar information through an auxiliary loss improves success by about 20 points. A shuffled-gold placebo suggests that exact content-context pairing is not the main active ingredient.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the Introduction for the failure chain, then focus on Proposition 1 and Proposition 2 to understand why bounded shaping can become large after z-scoring. In the experiments, prioritize the collapse curves, the ablation that removes standard-deviation normalization, and the signal-delivery matrix. For RL post-training work, the variance-profile criterion and early-warning diagnostics are the most reusable pieces. The synthetic POMDP and feature-coverage analysis are useful if one wants a more controlled account of when prediction-style signals fail.

recommendation.zh: GRPO稠密奖励崩溃的机制扎实且普适，做RL后训练或mid-train RL的人必须注意这个归一化坑，可直接复现验证避坑
recommendation.en: The mechanism of GRPO collapse with dense rewards is solid and generalizable; anyone doing RL post-training or mid-train RL must note this normalization pitfall

paper.title: Multi-turn RL with Structural and Performance Aware Rewards for CUDA Kernel Generation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful technique to enhance the reasoning capacity of LLMs for optimized code generation. However, existing RLVR approaches primarily rely on outcome-based signals such as correctness and speedup, overlooking performance-critical structural properties of programs that are essential for generating optimized code. In this work, we propose CudaPerf, a reflective RL framework that incorporates both verifiable execution rewards

summary.core_problem: 针对 CUDA kernel 生成，解决只用正确性和运行速度做 RLVR 奖励时，模型难以稳定学到高性能并行程序结构的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码后训练方法改进。它把结构性性能特征显式纳入奖励，对代码 RLVR 的信号设计有参考意义，但任务较窄，主要服务 CUDA kernel 优化，不直接推进基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CudaPerf，一个两阶段 reflective RL 框架。第一阶段离线训练 pairwise ranking 模块，通过对比强弱程序候选学习结构偏好；第二阶段在线 RL 同时优化正确性、性能和结构效率。结构奖励来自 memory coalescing、occupancy、arithmetic intensity、同步模式等并行程序特征。
summary.experiments: 摘要只给出方法框架，未提供完整模型规模、训练数据规模和具体提升数字。实验方向应是 CUDA kernel generation 中的正确性、speedup 和结构特征对比，baseline 包括只用 outcome-based correctness/speedup 的 RLVR 方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses CUDA kernel generation, where RLVR based only on correctness and runtime speed gives weak guidance for learning performance-critical parallel program structure.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method for code generation. Its useful part is reward design: structural program signals are added to verifiable rewards. The scope is narrow and CUDA-specific, so the connection to base-model pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: CudaPerf uses a two-stage reflective RL setup. An offline pairwise ranking module learns to separate strong and weak program candidates through contrastive comparisons. Online RL then optimizes a unified reward over correctness, measured performance, and structural efficiency features such as memory coalescing, occupancy, arithmetic intensity, and synchronization patterns.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, training data scale, or concrete gains. The expected evaluation is on CUDA kernel generation, comparing correctness, speedup, and structural metrics against outcome-only RLVR baselines.

recommendation.zh: 只看奖励定义和 offline ranker；结构信号有用，但 CUDA 任务太窄，不应外推到通用代码 RL。
recommendation.en: Read only the reward design and offline ranker; the structural signal is useful, but the CUDA-only setup should not be over-generalized to code RL.

paper.title: CMI-Mem: Toward Generalizable Long-Term Memory Management via CMI-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Memory Manager models are pivotal in agent systems. Existing methods rely predominantly on LLM-judged synthetic question-answer (QA) pairs, making memory valuation dependent on sampled queries and the downstream reader. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{CMI-Mem}, a reinforcement learning(RL)-based lightweight memory manager model with a hybrid reward that combines downstream QA correctness and intrinsic Conditional Mutual Information (CMI). CMI evaluates the information contributed

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent记忆管理方法依赖LLM评判的合成QA对做记忆估值，导致记忆价值依赖采样查询和下游阅读器，泛化性不足。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出结合下游QA正确性和内在条件互信息(CMI)的混合奖励RL记忆管理框架，减少对采样查询的依赖。
summary.technical_approach: 设计CMI-Mem轻量记忆管理器，采用RL训练，混合奖励由两部分组成：下游QA正确性奖励（保留任务对齐）+ CMI奖励（衡量新对话输入相对当前记忆状态的信息增益，无需条件于采样QA查询），二者互补。
summary.experiments: 开源了CMI-Mem-4B模型检查点和代码，在对话记忆管理任务上验证了CMI奖励对QA奖励的补充作用，提升了记忆估值的泛化性。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent memory management methods rely on LLM-judged synthetic QA pairs for memory valuation, making memory value dependent on sampled queries and the downstream reader, with poor generalization.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes an RL-based memory management framework with a hybrid reward combining downstream QA correctness and intrinsic Conditional Mutual Information, reducing dependence on sampled queries.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs CMI-Mem, a lightweight memory manager trained via RL with a two-part hybrid reward: downstream QA correctness (preserving task alignment) plus CMI reward (measuring information gain of new conversational inputs relative to current memory state, without conditioning on sampled QA queries), acting as complements.
summary_en.experiments: Open-sources the CMI-Mem-4B checkpoint and code; validates on conversational memory management tasks that the CMI reward complements QA reward and improves generalization of memory valuation.

recommendation.zh: Agent记忆管理的增量改进，CMI作为内在奖励的思路对RLHF奖励设计有微弱参考，仅看方法部分奖励定义即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in agent memory management; the CMI intrinsic reward idea gives weak reference for RLHF reward design, read only the reward definition in the method section.

paper.title: TimeLens2: Generalist Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can describe what happens in a video, but rarely identify when the supporting evidence occurs. We study generalist video temporal grounding, in which one model predicts a variable-cardinality set of evidence intervals across video lengths, domains, query forms, and viewpoints. Existing training strategies are misaligned with this set-valued task: long-video labels often rely on brittle one-pass annotation, while reinforcement-learning rewards either

summary.core_problem: 让视频多模态LLM不仅能“描述发生了什么”，还能输出支持答案的可变数量时间证据区间（temporal grounding）。
summary.importance: 把“证据定位”从单段匹配改成集合预测与集合级优化，外加一套可扩展的数据构建与奖励设计；对多模态预训练/后训练的监督形态与reward设计有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 将时间证据表示为区间集合进行监督与优化；构建TimeLens2-93K多跨度监督（caption proposal、独立定位、cross-agent共识、语义验证、边界精修）；提出基于区间并集支持的1D Wasserstein (W1) reward，避免RL中非重叠预测难区分与脆弱的segment matching。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模与具体SOTA幅度；强调跨视频长度/域/查询形式/视角的泛化与集合式训练策略优于既有一遍标注或脆弱RL匹配奖励。

summary_en.core_problem: Enable video MLLMs to output a variable-cardinality set of temporal evidence intervals, not just describe content.
summary_en.importance: Reframes temporal grounding as set prediction with set-level supervision and reward; the data construction and reward design are directly useful for multimodal pre/post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Represent evidence as an interval set; build TimeLens2-93K with multi-span supervision via caption proposals, independent localization, cross-agent consensus, semantic verification, and boundary refinement; propose an exact 1D Wasserstein (W1) reward over merged interval supports to avoid brittle segment matching in RL.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size or exact gains; claims better alignment than one-pass long-video labels and prior RL rewards across diverse lengths/domains/query forms/viewpoints.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“区间集合”监督+W1奖励这套对齐方式；先读奖励定义与数据构建流程，效果数字再决定是否复现。
recommendation.en: Focus on the interval-set formulation and the W1 reward; read the reward definition + data pipeline first, then decide whether results justify replication.

paper.title: Toward Anthropomorphic Dialogue: A Closed-Loop Framework for Human-Like Chat Generation, Evaluation, and Preference Alignment
paper.abstract: Human-like private chat requires more than fluent response generation: a system must preserve persona, relationship, memory, bounded knowledge, medium-specific timing, and a coherent multi-turn arc. We present AnthroDial, a closed-loop framework that formulates anthropomorphic dialogue as a joint problem of system architecture, executable evaluation, and diagnostic alignment. It combines (1) a role-conditioned scheduled dialogue runtime with persona and scenario cards, long-term memory, virtual

summary.core_problem: 解决私聊式人类化对话中，模型如何同时保持 persona、关系、记忆、知识边界、时间节奏和多轮叙事一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练系统和可执行评估框架。它把 dialogue runtime、benchmark、SFT 数据过滤和 GRPO 偏好优化放在一个闭环中，对长程对话对齐和 reward 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: AnthroDial 包含三部分：角色条件化的 scheduled dialogue runtime，带 persona/scenario cards、长期记忆、虚拟时间和 single-draft 决策；一个可执行 benchmark，包含 L0 validity gate、五个 per-turn 维度和五个 dialogue-level 维度；一个后训练流程，从 scheduled-decision 数据中过滤 16,436 条样本做 SFT，并用带认知诊断和 ZPD 感知的 reward 做 GRPO。reward 用 Kalman filter 估计各行为维度能力，对能力缺口更大的维度加权，并用 rollout 分数匹配任务级 ZPD。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出 16,436 条 SFT scheduled-decision examples，但未说明底座模型、参数量、训练 token、baseline 或量化提升。需要看正文中 GRPO 相对普通偏好 reward、固定 rubric reward 和仅 SFT 的消融。
summary.authors_note: 摘要标注为 Cohere 相关工作；未能从给定信息确认具体知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets human-like private chat, where a model must maintain persona, relationship state, memory, bounded knowledge, timing, and coherent multi-turn arcs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training system plus executable evaluation framework. It connects a dialogue runtime, benchmark, SFT filtering, and GRPO-based preference optimization, making it relevant to long-horizon dialogue alignment and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: AnthroDial has three components: a role-conditioned scheduled dialogue runtime with persona and scenario cards, long-term memory, virtual time, and single-draft decisions; an executable benchmark with an L0 validity gate, five per-turn dimensions, and five dialogue-level dimensions; and a post-training pipeline that filters 16,436 scheduled-decision examples for SFT and applies GRPO with a cognitive-diagnostic, ZPD-aware reward. The reward uses Kalman-filtered capability estimates per behavior dimension, upweights weak dimensions, and uses rollout scores for task-level ZPD matching.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 16,436 SFT examples but does not specify the base model, parameter count, training budget, baselines, or quantitative gains. The key evidence should be the ablation of GRPO against fixed-rubric rewards, standard preference rewards, and SFT-only training.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is marked as associated with Cohere. No specific well-known author background can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 奖励按能力缺口动态加权这点可借鉴；其余偏聊天产品化，读 reward 和 eval 设计即可。
recommendation.en: The adaptive deficit-weighted reward is the part to inspect; much of the rest is chat-product scaffolding.

paper.title: Multi-Axis Max@K Reinforcement Learning for Representative Diversity in Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models can synthesize realistic, prompt-aligned images, yet samples generated for the same prompt often cover only a small subset of visually distinct modes. This limits the diversity of images, and for person-centric prompts, can reflect or amplify demographic skew. We formalize this problem as coverage of a predefined set of semantically specified modes, which we call target-mode coverage. We then propose multi-axis max@K, a group-based reinforcement learning objective for

summary.core_problem: 同一文本提示下，文生图扩散模型往往只覆盖少数视觉模式；论文要提高一组生成样本对预定义语义类别的覆盖度，尤其是人物提示中的人口属性多样性。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向生成多样性的强化学习目标，而不是新的基础模型架构。它把“多样性”从样本级平均得分改成组级模式覆盖，对理解生成模型后训练中的信用分配有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 multi-axis max@K。对同一 prompt 生成 K 个样本，并对每个目标类别计算分数；目标函数先在样本维度对每个类别取最大值，再对类别求和。这样只有当某个样本提高了某一类别的组内最大覆盖时，它才在该类别上获得正向权重，避免所有样本被推向同一个高分模式。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到先在合成任务上验证信用分配机制，再用于 diffusion-based T2I 模型的训练；核心对比应是常规奖励聚合或单样本奖励下的模式覆盖、多样性和 prompt alignment。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Yutaka Matsuo 是东京大学松尾研究室负责人，团队长期做深度学习、LLM 应用和生成模型相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses mode under-coverage in text-to-image diffusion models, where multiple samples from the same prompt often represent only a narrow set of visually distinct semantic modes.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an RL objective for diversity-oriented generative model alignment. It is not a foundation-model pretraining result, but the group-level credit assignment idea is relevant to reward design for generative systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed multi-axis max@K objective generates a group of K samples per prompt, scores each sample against multiple target categories, takes the maximum score over samples for each category, and then sums those category-wise maxima. A sample receives positive credit only when it improves the group maximum for a category.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a synthetic validation of the credit-assignment mechanism and experiments on diffusion-based T2I models. It implies comparisons against standard reward aggregation or per-sample reward baselines, but does not provide model size, training scale, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Yutaka Matsuo leads the Matsuo Lab at the University of Tokyo, a group known for work on deep learning, LLM applications, and generative models.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧不用细读；只看目标函数定义，作为“组级奖励避免模式坍缩”的一个小型可复用 trick。
recommendation.en: No need to read deeply for pretraining; inspect the objective as a compact example of group-level reward design against mode collapse.

paper.title: CoRe: A Comprehensive Framework for Cross-Image Comparative Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Cross-image comparative reasoning remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs), especially when correct prediction requires fine-grained attribute grounding and globally consistent reasoning. We present CoRe, a unified framework for this problem. CoRe includes: (i) CoRe-20K, a large-scale triplet-based training set automatically constructed from structured visual metadata through a multi-expert collaborative pipeline, covering counting, depth, distance, and spatial relations; (ii) TriSR

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在多图比较推理中难以同时完成细粒度属性定位、跨图判断和全局一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态推理数据、训练框架和评测资产的组合。它把 cross-image comparative reasoning 单独拎出来，覆盖计数、深度、距离、空间关系等需要比较而非单图识别的能力，对 VLM 后训练和评测有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoRe 框架，包括从结构化视觉元数据自动构造的 CoRe-20K 三元组训练集，以及 TriSR 结构化奖励。TriSR 在 GRPO 优化中同时约束属性 grounding、判断对齐和 triplet consistency，避免只用最终答案奖励导致模型学到表面比较模式。
summary.experiments: 在 CoRe-Bench 上评测多图细粒度比较推理能力。摘要报告 CoRe 相比最强 baseline 的 partial accuracy 提升 28.2 个百分点，同时在常规多模态 benchmark 上保持竞争力。未给出模型规模、训练 token 或具体 baseline 名称。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets VLM failures in cross-image comparative reasoning, where models must ground fine-grained attributes and maintain consistent judgments across multiple images.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a combined data, reward, and benchmark package for multi-image VLM reasoning. The task isolates comparative capabilities such as counting, depth, distance, and spatial relations, which are not well captured by standard single-image VQA setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoRe builds a triplet-based training set, CoRe-20K, from structured visual metadata through a multi-expert construction pipeline. It also introduces TriSR, a structured reward scheme for GRPO that supervises attribute grounding, judgment alignment, and triplet-level consistency instead of relying only on final-answer reward.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are centered on CoRe-Bench. The abstract reports a 28.2-point gain in partial accuracy over the strongest baseline while remaining competitive on standard multimodal benchmarks. Model scale, training size beyond CoRe-20K, and detailed baselines are not specified in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据构造和 TriSR 奖励设计；它更像 VLM 后训练 recipe，不会改变基座预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the data construction and TriSR reward design; this is more a VLM post-training recipe than a base-pretraining signal.

paper.title: When Does Reward Teach State? A Hidden-Automaton Instrument and the Group-Language Boundary
paper.abstract: Does a reinforcement-learning agent that earns high reward represent its task's latent state, or only a reward-correlated shortcut? The question is usually unanswerable: the "true state" is undefined. We make it exactly answerable with a white-box instrument: express the task as a hidden deterministic finite automaton (DFA), let the agent observe a symbol stream and intermittently choose the next symbol under partial control, and grant one sparse terminal reward for acceptance. Knowing the autom

summary.core_problem: 无法可测量地区分高奖励RL智能体是学到了任务隐状态，还是仅利用了与奖励相关的捷径
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，首次提出白盒隐藏自动机（DFA）工具，将奖励获得与隐状态学习解耦为可独立测量的指标
summary.technical_approach: 将任务建模为确定性有限自动机，智能体观测符号流并间歇选择下一个符号，仅在自动机接受时给予稀疏终端奖励；利用DFA已知的最优回报和精确隐状态真值，分别测量奖励得分和状态表示学习情况
summary.experiments: 实验发现弱on-policy RL设置下，无论采用何种架构，智能体都能获得高奖励但隐状态探测结果处于随机水平

summary_en.core_problem: There is no measurable way to distinguish whether high-reward RL agents learn the task's latent state or only exploit reward-correlated shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical analysis contribution, first proposing a white-box hidden DFA instrument to decouple reward acquisition and latent state learning into independently measurable metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models the task as a deterministic finite automaton, where the agent observes a symbol stream and intermittently selects the next symbol, receiving only a sparse terminal reward upon acceptance; uses the DFA's known optimal return and exact latent state ground truth to measure reward score and state representation learning separately.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show that under weak on-policy RL, regardless of architecture, agents achieve high reward while latent state probe performance remains at chance level.

recommendation.zh: RL基础机制分析，对RLHF奖励信号设计有弱参考价值，仅看摘要和§4实验结论即可
recommendation.en: Basic RL mechanism analysis with weak reference value for RLHF reward design; only read the abstract and §4 experiment conclusions.

paper.title: RLVP: Penalize the Path, Reward the Outcome
paper.abstract: Agents acting on our behalf in the real world (e.g. placing phone calls) must learn online from costly, often irreversible interactions rather than cheap simulator steps. Two things follow. First, deployability depends on the path, not only the outcome. An agent must respect outcome-neutral constraints such as not repeatedly calling an unresponsive user, respecting business hours, or completing required authentication constraints that outcome-based rewards cannot express, since violating them fr

summary.core_problem: 真实世界Agent在线学习中，现有RLVR方法仅优化最终结果，无法表达结果中立的路径约束，且在全失败样本组中浪费昂贵的交互rollout。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出“路径惩罚+结果奖励”的RL范式，同时提升在线学习的样本效率，为真实世界Agent的合规部署提供新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RLVP方法，在可验证结果奖励基础上引入低成本的路径约束惩罚项；针对全失败组设计更高效的优势估计机制以减少样本浪费（摘要截断，细节不全）。
summary.experiments: 针对真实世界Agent交互场景设计，具体实验设置、模型及量化结果摘要未完整披露。

summary_en.core_problem: In online learning for real-world agents, existing RLVR methods only optimize final outcomes, cannot express outcome-agnostic path constraints, and waste expensive interaction rollouts on all-failure sample groups.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing an RL paradigm of "path penalization + outcome reward", while improving sample efficiency of online learning, providing new ideas for compliant deployment of real-world agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes RLVP (Reinforcement Learning with Path Penalization), which introduces low-cost path constraint penalties on top of verifiable outcome rewards; designs more efficient advantage estimation for all-failure groups to reduce sample waste (abstract truncated, details incomplete).
summary_en.experiments: Designed for real-world agent interaction scenarios; specific experimental setup, model, and quantitative results not fully disclosed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 路径惩罚+结果奖励的思路可迁移到LLM推理/Agent的后训练RL设计中，看摘要了解核心思路即可。
recommendation.en: The path penalization + outcome reward idea can be transferred to RL design for LLM reasoning/agent post-training; read only the abstract for core intuition.

paper.title: Bridging Physical Reasoning and Task Generalization via Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to generalize in interactive physical reasoning, particularly under unseen tasks and environments. Two key failure modes are prominent: hallucinated chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning that contradicts physical reality, and misalignment between the model's reasoning and actions. We present VAORA (Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment), a novel reward design that directly addresses both issues. VAORA introduces two complementary rewards: Visual Alignment Re

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在交互式物理推理中面对未见任务和环境时，推理内容脱离视觉现实、且 reasoning 与 action 不一致的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 VLM 后训练/对齐方向的工作，关注 reasoning-action alignment 与物理一致性。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它暴露了视觉推理模型在交互环境中的失配模式，以及奖励设计如何约束语言推理贴近环境反馈。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VAORA 奖励设计，包含两部分：Visual Alignment Reward，用于约束推理与当前视觉上下文一致；Visual-Action Alignment Reward，用于约束推理与模型动作导致的视觉结果一致。为提升训练稳定性，作者还利用预训练领域内 expert agent 估计成功概率，构造更平滑、更稠密的奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 在 PHYRE 和 Virtual Tool 等交互式物理推理环境上实验，目标是提升未见任务和环境下的泛化。摘要强调其能减少 hallucinated CoT 并缩小 reasoning-behavior gap，但未给出模型规模、训练数据量和具体提升幅度。实验更偏任务对齐而非基座模型训练。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Ming-Hsuan Yang、Yu-Chiang Frank Wang。仅从摘要无法确认完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode of VLMs in interactive physical reasoning: under unseen tasks and environments, their chain-of-thought can contradict visual reality and become misaligned with the actions they take.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM post-training/alignment paper focused on reasoning-action alignment and physical consistency. Its value to pretraining researchers is mostly diagnostic: it exposes where visually grounded reasoning breaks in interactive settings and how reward design can tether language reasoning to environmental feedback.
summary_en.technical_approach: VAORA introduces two rewards: a Visual Alignment Reward that anchors reasoning to the current visual context, and a Visual-Action Alignment Reward that anchors reasoning to the visual outcome induced by the model's action. To stabilize training, the method uses a pretrained in-domain expert agent to estimate success probabilities and provide smoother, denser rewards.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on interactive physical reasoning environments such as PHYRE and Virtual Tool, with a focus on generalization to unseen tasks and environments. The abstract claims reduced hallucinated CoT and a smaller reasoning-behavior gap, but does not report model sizes, data scale, or exact gains. The setup is more task-alignment oriented than foundation-model training oriented.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Ming-Hsuan Yang and Yu-Chiang Frank Wang. Full institutional affiliation cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但它把“reasoning 看起来对”和“action 真能落地”拆成两个奖励，诊断味道比方法味道更重；只看奖励定义和失败案例就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the split between visually grounded reasoning and action-outcome alignment is a useful diagnostic lens; reading the reward design and failure cases is enough.

paper.title: On the effectiveness of reward functions in reinforcement learning for confidence calibration of large language models
paper.abstract: In this paper, we consider the setting where large language models (LLMs) are trained using reinforcement learning (RL) to simultaneously improve reasoning accuracy and verbalize its confidence. Our reward scheme uses two functions for rewarding confidence verbalized by the LLM: one when the LLM is correct and a different one when the LLM is incorrect. With a poorly designed reward scheme, the LLM may be incentivized to answer incorrectly so that it can be confident that its answer is indeed inc

summary.core_problem: 研究RL用于LLM置信度校准时，奖励函数设计不当会引发「置信度奖励黑客」现象——模型故意答错问题以获得更高奖励，同时需要在不损失推理准确率的前提下实现良好的置信度校准。
summary.importance: RL对齐与置信度校准交叉领域的基础工作，明确了置信度奖励黑客的定义，推导了不可黑客化奖励方案的理论边界，对RL后训练阶段的奖励设计有直接指导意义，也能为预训练后期引入校准信号提供设计准则。
summary.technical_approach: 将奖励方案定义为答对时的置信度依赖函数f(c)与答错时的置信度依赖函数g(c)组成的二元组；理论推导了不可黑客化奖励方案的充要条件，保证「尽力答对并诚实上报置信度」的期望奖励始终高于「故意答错」的期望；进一步设计了覆盖「偏好欠置信」到「偏好过置信」的连续奖励方案谱系，允许根据应用场景调整准确率与校准效果的权衡。
summary.experiments: 在实用推理数据集上验证，使用不在不可黑客化集合内的奖励方案时，LLM会选择性故意答错部分问题以最大化奖励；不同非黑客化奖励方案对应不同的准确率-校准权衡曲线，奖励方案选型可作为调优超参数。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第2章问题建模与理论推导部分，以及附录A.1的置信度奖励黑客具体示例；实验部分可泛读不同奖励方案的权衡对比，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates reward function design flaws in RL-based LLM confidence calibration that trigger "confidence reward hacking" — a phenomenon where models intentionally answer questions incorrectly to maximize reward, while addressing the need to achieve solid calibration without sacrificing reasoning accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Foundational work at the intersection of RL alignment and confidence calibration. It formalizes the definition of confidence reward hacking, derives theoretical boundaries for non-hackable reward schemes, provides direct guidance for reward design in RL post-training, and offers design principles for introducing calibration signals during late-stage pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines a reward scheme as a tuple of two confidence-dependent functions: f(c) for correct answers and g(c) for incorrect answers. Theoretically derives the necessary and sufficient conditions for non-hackable schemes, which guarantee the expected reward of answering optimally and reporting confidence honestly is always higher than that of intentional wrong answers. Further designs a continuous spectrum of non-hackable schemes ranging from underconfidence-preferred to overconfidence-preferred, enabling application-specific tradeoffs between accuracy and calibration.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically validates on practical reasoning datasets that LLMs trained with hackable reward schemes selectively answer some questions incorrectly to maximize reward. Different non-hackable schemes produce distinct accuracy-calibration tradeoff curves, confirming reward scheme selection as a valid tuning hyperparameter.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (problem formulation and theoretical derivation) and Appendix A.1 (concrete examples of confidence reward hacking). Skim experiment sections for tradeoff comparisons across schemes. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 RLHF/RLVR 的人该看：它提醒你 reward 不是“调个系数”这么简单，先检查是否存在自信答错也能拿高分的漏洞，再谈 calibration。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you design RL rewards: it shows confidence calibration is not a coefficient-tuning problem but a reward-spec issue that can literally pay the model to be wrong.

paper.title: RSPO: Reward-Swap Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning holds significant potential for training large language models (LLMs) to handle multi-turn interactive tasks. However, in long-horizon, multi-turn tasks characterized by sparse outcome rewards, directly training with outcome rewards often results in slow convergence due to the sparsity of signals and the lack of fine-grained feedback. Furthermore, the model may fail to learn successful trajectories that are not sampled during training, thereby limiting its performance. Con

summary.core_problem: 多轮LLM智能体任务中，稀疏终局奖励导致RL训练收敛慢、探索不足，而稠密过程奖励易与终局奖励存在偏差、损害最终性能，现有方法难以同时兼顾训练效率与目标对齐。
summary.importance: 其利用稠密信号拓展探索空间、再用稀疏信号校正训练方向的双循环思路，可迁移至预训练后推理增强对齐、多轮交互对齐等场景，为混合奖励信号的设计提供了可参考的范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出奖励交换策略优化（RSPO），一套循环式RL训练框架。框架包含两个智能体：智能体A先用稠密过程奖励训练k步，得到探索能力更强的智能体B。智能体B负责探索并收集多样化轨迹，这些轨迹标注终局奖励后，以off-policy方式回传更新智能体A。核心逻辑是，仅用终局奖励训练的模型行为会被限制在狭小空间内，稠密过程奖励能推动模型探索更大的行为空间，终局奖励则保证训练方向与真实目标一致。RSPO可兼容GRPO、GiGPO、PPO等多种现有RL算法。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld（具身居家任务）和WebShop（网页搜索交互任务）两个多轮基准上测试，基模型为Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct。RSPO在所有任务上的平均性能提升为：较GRPO高4.87%，较GiGPO高3.6%，较PPO高6.6%。细分场景下，ALFWorld中较GRPO提升5.7%、较PPO提升8.6%；WebShop中较GRPO提升5.5%、较PPO提升12%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3节的RSPO框架设计与算法流程，以及第4节的主实验结果。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-turn LLM agent tasks, existing RL methods face a tradeoff between training efficiency and objective alignment: sparse outcome rewards cause slow convergence and limited exploration, while dense process rewards often misalign with ground-truth outcome rewards and degrade final performance.
summary_en.importance: Its dual-cycle logic of using dense signals to expand exploration space and sparse signals to correct training direction can be transferred to scenarios like post-pretraining reasoning-augmented alignment and multi-turn interactive alignment, providing a referable paradigm for hybrid reward signal design.
summary_en.technical_approach: This work proposes Reward-Swap Policy Optimization (RSPO), a cyclic reinforcement learning framework with two agents. Agent A is first trained with dense process rewards for k steps to produce Agent B with stronger exploration capability. Agent B explores and collects diverse trajectories, which are annotated with outcome rewards and used to update Agent A in an off-policy manner. The core insight is that models trained solely on outcome rewards are constrained to a narrow behavioral space; dense process rewards push the model to explore a larger space, while outcome rewards ensure training stays aligned with the true objective. RSPO is compatible with multiple existing RL algorithms including GRPO, GiGPO, and PPO.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on two multi-turn benchmarks: ALFWorld (embodied household tasks) and WebShop (web search interaction tasks), with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct as the base model. RSPO achieves average performance improvements of 4.87% over GRPO, 3.6% over GiGPO, and 6.6% over PPO across all tasks. Specifically, it outperforms GRPO by 5.7% and PPO by 8.6% on ALFWorld, and outperforms GRPO by 5.5% and PPO by 12% on WebShop.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 3 for RSPO framework design and algorithm pipeline, and Section 4 for main experimental results. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 结合密集与稀疏奖励的RL训练思路对多轮Agent训练有参考，重点看奖励切换机制的设计与实验验证强度
recommendation.en: The dense+sparse reward RL approach is informative for multi-turn agent training; examine reward switching design and experimental validation

paper.title: Optimizing Visual Generative Models via Distribution-wise Rewards
paper.abstract: Conventional reinforcement learning strategies for visual generation typically employ sample-wise reward functions, yet this practice frequently results in reward hacking that degrades image diversity and introduces visual anomalies. To address these limitations, we present a novel framework that finetunes generative models using distribution-wise rewards, ensuring better alignment with real-world data distributions. Unlike rewards that evaluate samples individually, distribution-wise reward acc

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉生成模型用逐样本 reward 做 RL 微调时容易 reward hacking、损害多样性并产生异常图像的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型后训练方法。它把 reward 从单样本评价改成分布级评价，目标是让生成样本整体更接近真实数据分布，而不是让每个样本独立朝同一奖励方向塌缩。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 distribution-wise reward finetuning 框架。核心是用一组生成样本的分布统计来给奖励信号，并用 subset-replace 策略降低分布奖励估计成本：只替换参考生成集合中的小子集来近似奖励变化。还尝试用 RL 优化 post-hoc model merging 系数，以缓解训练和推理目标不一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集和具体数值。实验应以视觉生成模型为对象，对比常规 sample-wise reward RL 微调，关注图像质量、多样性、mode collapse 和视觉异常；作者声称 distribution-wise reward 能改善对真实数据分布的对齐并减轻多样性退化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses reward hacking and diversity collapse when visual generative models are fine-tuned with sample-wise RL rewards.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for generative models. It shifts the reward signal from individual samples to the generated distribution, aiming to match real data statistics instead of pushing every sample along the same reward gradient.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework uses distribution-wise rewards for fine-tuning. A subset-replace strategy makes reward estimation cheaper by updating only a small subset of a generated reference set. The paper also applies RL to post-hoc model-merging coefficients, targeting train-inference mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or exact numbers. The comparisons appear to be against conventional sample-wise reward optimization for visual generators, with evaluation centered on visual quality, diversity, mode collapse, and artifacts.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 reward 设计部分；对 LLM RLHF 的借鉴是“分布级信号抗塌缩”，但视觉生成 setup 不能直接外推。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward formulation; the useful prior is distribution-level signals against collapse, but the visual-generation setup should not be over-transferred to RLHF.

paper.title: Evidence-State Rewards for Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-context reasoning requires models to locate, revise, and synthesize evidence distributed across lengthy inputs. Existing long-context RL methods usually reward final answers or static evidence extraction, offering little feedback on how intermediate actions change the model's evidence state. We propose Maven, a reinforcement learning framework with an editable evidence memory. Maven defines an answer-conditioned evidence-state value and rewards action-level state transitions: add actions ar

summary.core_problem: 现有长上下文推理的 RL 奖励主要监督最终答案或静态证据抽取，无法反馈模型在推理过程中对证据集合进行增删、关联、修正的中间状态变化，容易导致模型过早锚定局部证据、无法丢弃干扰项、也难以组合分散证据。
summary.importance: 属于 post-train / long-context reasoning 方向的过程奖励设计，对预训练研究的直接启发在于两点：一是它把长上下文推理拆解为显式的证据状态转移，这种结构化中间表示与近年 reasoning trace / latent reasoning 的训练信号设计思路相通；二是动作级 credit assignment 的做法说明，仅靠 outcome reward 不足以训练长程依赖下的信息整合行为，对设计 pretrain-posttrain 闭环中的细粒度监督有参考价值。但它不是基座预训练方法本身，影响力主要在长上下文 RL 和过程奖励。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Maven，一个带可编辑 evidence memory 的 RL 框架。模型生成轨迹时可执行四类动作：add 将某段上下文加入证据记忆，link 说明两条已有证据如何联合支撑答案，drop 删除无关或误导性证据，answer 输出最终答案。核心是定义 answer-conditioned evidence-state value：对当前问题 Q、证据集合 E 和标准答案 a⋆，用冻结 verifier 计算 teacher-forced 下答案的 NLL，再用加入证据前后的相对 NLL 下降作为证据状态价值。基于该状态价值，给每个动作分配局部过程奖励：add 看边际增益和 hindsight 贡献，link 看证据协同带来的联合价值提升，drop 看移除误导证据后答案支撑度是否改善，answer 看最终答案正确性。这些动作级奖励随后在 GRPO 中分配到对应生成 span。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B、Qwen3-30B-A3B 上评测 LongBench v2、LongReason、RULER。论文报告 Maven 相比 outcome-only RL 和已有 evidence-aware reward，在最终答案准确率上有一致提升，同时诊断指标显示证据充分性提高、distractor 留存减少。当前提供的全文截断了实验详细表格，无法核对具体百分点和消融拆分，但方法的主要 empirical claim 是跨模型族、跨 benchmark 稳定增益，并且不是只提升显式引用质量，而是改善证据修订和组合行为。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议重点看方法部分的动作定义、evidence-state value 公式，以及三类非 answer 动作的 reward 设计逻辑。如果关心长上下文 RL，可以再看后面的证据充分性/干扰项留存诊断。预计阅读 20–30 分钟。不需要把它当成 pretrain 核心论文，但对理解 process reward 如何从结果监督走向状态转移监督有帮助。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL methods for long-context reasoning mostly reward final answers or static evidence extraction, and therefore give little feedback on how intermediate actions revise the model’s evolving evidence state. This encourages premature commitment to partial evidence, failure to discard distractors, and weak synthesis of evidence scattered across long inputs.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training / long-context RL paper rather than a base pretraining method, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers because it makes the reasoning process structurally explicit: long-context reasoning is modeled as a sequence of edits to an evidence state rather than a single retrieval step. The local, action-level credit assignment is a useful example of how sparse outcome reward can be insufficient for long-horizon information integration, which matters for broader work on process supervision, reasoning traces, and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: Maven adds an editable evidence memory to RL training. The policy can emit four action types: add a context span to memory, link two existing pieces of evidence by explaining their joint support for the answer, drop a misleading or redundant item, and answer. At each step, evidence-state value is defined as the answer-conditioned utility of the current memory: a frozen verifier computes teacher-forced answer NLL given the question and evidence set, and value is measured by relative NLL reduction. Action-level rewards are then assigned locally in GRPO: add is rewarded by marginal gain and hindsight contribution, link by evidence synergy, drop by improved answer support after removing the item, and answer by final correctness.
summary_en.experiments: Maven is evaluated on Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B across LongBench v2, LongReason, and RULER. The paper reports consistent gains over outcome-only RL and prior evidence-aware rewards on final-answer accuracy, with diagnostic evidence of higher evidence sufficiency and lower distractor retention. The available text is truncated before the result tables, so exact numbers and ablation breakdowns cannot be verified from the provided content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the methodology first, especially the action space, the answer-conditioned evidence-state value, and how rewards are assigned to add/link/drop transitions rather than to static evidence chunks. If interested in long-context RL, continue to the diagnostic metrics on sufficiency and distractor retention. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文RL从结果监督转向证据状态过程监督的创新，动作级奖励分配的设计可直接迁移到预训练中间推理信号的构造，重点看§3.2的奖励定义和§4的GRPO对齐细节。
recommendation.en: Innovates long-context RL by shifting from outcome supervision to evidence-state process supervision; action-level reward design can be directly adapted to construct intermediate reasoning signals for pretraining, focus on §3.2 reward definition and §4 GRPO alignment details.

paper.title: Verifiable Rewards for Calibrated Probabilistic Forecasting
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can in principle train calibrated probabilistic forecasters, since a proper scoring rule such as the Brier score is computed from outcomes alone and is minimized in expectation by the true probability. In practice it degrades calibration, and existing remedies address epistemic uncertainty, where a model's confidence accompanies a verifiably correct or incorrect answer. We study aleatoric forecasting, where the forecast itself is the output and the

summary.core_problem: 用可验证奖励（RLVR）训练概率预测模型时，为什么对单次随机结果做奖励会让概率校准恶化，以及如何在 aleatoric uncertainty（输出本身就是概率、标签只是一次随机采样）场景下获得校准良好的预测。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对理解 RL post-training 在概率估计任务上的失败模式有直接参考价值，尤其是两个点：一是高方差的逐样本奖励会把策略拉向单次实现而非真实条件概率；二是 policy gradient 作用在 chain-of-thought token 上会污染推理，让文字理由与最终概率脱钩。这两个机制与通用 LLM 的校准、RL 训练中 reasoning 被 reward hacking 的问题相通。
summary.technical_approach: 任务选的是 NFL 比赛中逐档进攻的实时胜率预测。状态包含比分、剩余时间、档数距离、码位、持球方、赛前让分；标签只是该场比赛最终胜负这一次伯努利观测。作者发现直接对逐 play 的 Brier score 做 RL 会通过两条路径破坏校准：第一，单次结果噪声太大，对该结果打分会把梯度引向偶然发生的结局；第二，如果模型先生成推理再输出概率，梯度回传到 reasoning token 会重写思维链，使其不再支持最终概率。修复方法对应两点：第一，奖励不使用单次 outcome，而使用基于历史数据分桶估计的状态条件经验胜率，提供一个可验证、不带单样本标签噪声的目标；第二，要么直接预测概率而不生成 CoT，要么在答案 token 上施加梯度 mask，只让最终答案位置接收策略梯度，保持 reasoning 不被优化扭曲。
summary.experiments: 基座模型为 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，不经过 SFT，直接做 RL。训练集是 2015–2022 赛季，验证集 2023，测试集 2024。直接预测版本在测试集上 ECE 为 0.029，与博彩市场的 0.027 接近，Brier score 追平前沿零样本模型和表格经验估计器；博彩市场剩余优势主要来自模型看不到的现场实时信息。使用经验胜率作为奖励时，在 held-out 比赛上 Brier 距市场仅差 0.007。若不对 CoT 做梯度隔离，训练会把 ECE 从 0.19 恶化到 0.30；使用 answer-span gradient mask 后，推理与最终概率不一致的比例从 22.4% 降到 4.4%，sharpness 仅有小幅损失。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看 introduction 与 Section 4 中两个失败机制的拆分：一个失败来自奖励噪声，一个失败来自 CoT 上的梯度污染。图表重点看 Figure 1 的训练对比和 ablation 中 full-completion gradient 与 answer-masked gradient 的校准差异。对做 RL/verifiable reward 的读者，值得关注“把高方差 outcome 换成状态条件经验估计”这一操作在其他随机性任务上的可迁移性。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。
summary.authors_note: Jasper Research，具体作者信息从提供文本中无法完全确认。

summary_en.core_problem: Why reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards fails to produce calibrated probabilistic forecasts when the reward is scored against single stochastic outcomes, and how to fix this failure under aleatoric uncertainty, where the model outputs a probability and the label is only one realized draw.
summary_en.importance: The paper gives a clean dissection of two failure modes that are relevant beyond sports forecasting: high-variance per-sample rewards pull the policy toward realized outcomes rather than the true conditional probability, and policy gradients applied to chain-of-thought tokens corrupt the reasoning so that stated probabilities no longer follow from the argument. Both mechanisms speak directly to broader concerns about calibration and reward hacking in RL post-training of LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The testbed is in-game win probability for NFL plays. The state encodes score margin, time remaining, down and distance, field position, possession, and the public pregame spread; the label is the single realized win/loss outcome. Direct RL on the per-play Brier score decalibrates the model for two reasons. First, one outcome is a noisy Bernoulli draw from the unobserved true rate, so the reward has high variance and chases the realized result. Second, when the model generates reasoning before the answer, the policy gradient rewrites the reasoning tokens into incoherent arguments that no longer support the stated probability. The fix is twofold: replace the per-play outcome with a state-bucketed empirical win rate estimated from historical data as a verifiable, low-variance reward target, and either drop chain-of-thought and predict directly or mask the gradient so that only answer tokens receive policy gradients.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is trained without SFT on 2015–2022 seasons, selected on 2023, and evaluated on held-out 2024 games. Direct prediction reaches an ECE of 0.029, close to the betting market at 0.027, and matches a frontier zero-shot model as well as a tabular estimator on Brier score; the remaining edge of the market is attributed to live in-game information unavailable to all public-state models. The empirical-rate reward is within 0.007 Brier of the market on held-out games. Training the full completion under the rate target degrades ECE from 0.19 to 0.30, while confining gradients to answer tokens keeps calibration near the market. Gradient masking on the answer span reduces the rate at which the stated probability is unsupported by the reasoning from 22.4% to 4.4%, with only a small loss in sharpness.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, with attention to the two-way decomposition of failure in the introduction and Section 4: reward noise versus CoT corruption by gradients. Focus on Figure 1 and the ablations comparing full-completion gradients with answer-masked gradients. Readers working on RLVR or calibration should ask whether the empirical-rate reward trick transfers to other aleatoric prediction settings. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.
